title: Nonzero bilinear form probability
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $D$ be a nonzero $n\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb{F}_2$. If $x$ and $y$ are chosen independently and uniformly from $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, then $\mathbb{P}(x^{\mathsf T}Dy\neq 0)\geq 1/4$.
